about: Ten short credit memo drafts with a human pass or fail label, used to calibrate the LLM judge in evals/judge.py. All companies, people and figures are synthetic. Rohan runs Konark Packaging Pvt Ltd and applies to Good Bank; Priya is the credit analyst. A memo passes only when it is faithful to the policy checks, contains all eight sections, uses no approval language, and cites at least one policy rule id.
labelled_by: Priya (credit analyst) and the head of credit, two passes, disagreements resolved by the head of credit

cases.label: pass
cases.reason: All eight sections, every number matches the checks, cites rules 3.1 and 4.1, and it recommends rather than decides.

checks.rule_text: No more than 3 cheque returns in 12 months

cases.memo:
# Credit memo: A014

## Applicant summary
Konark Packaging Pvt Ltd, a corrugated box manufacturer in the West region, trading since 2016 with 84 employees. Promoter: Rohan.

## Facility requested
Term Loan of INR 18,500 thousand over 48 months for a second corrugation line.

## Financial analysis
FY2026 revenue INR 412,000 thousand, EBITDA INR 51,400 thousand. DSCR of 1.62 against the rule 3.1 floor of 1.25. Debt to EBITDA 2.1.

## Banking conduct
Average monthly inflow INR 4,725 thousand with volatility of 0.14. One cheque return in twelve months against the rule 4.1 limit of three.

## Related parties and group exposure
One linked entity through a shared director. Combined group exposure INR 26,900 thousand, inside the section 5.2 limit.

## Risk score
Model probability of default 0.06, band low. The main drivers are the loan term and the size of the facility.

## Policy exceptions
None.

## Recommendation: approve_with_conditions
Recommend a facility subject to a charge over the new machinery and quarterly stock statements. A human underwriter must take the final decision.

cases.label: fail
cases.reason: Related parties, risk score and policy exceptions are all missing, so the underwriter cannot see group exposure at all.

cases.memo:
# Credit memo: A003

## Applicant summary
Konark Packaging Pvt Ltd, West region, corrugated packaging, promoter Rohan.

## Facility requested
Working Capital of INR 7,800 thousand over 36 months.

## Financial analysis
DSCR measured at 1.08 against the rule 3.1 floor of 1.25. The shortfall follows a one-off plant shutdown in the second quarter.

## Banking conduct
No cheque returns. Average monthly inflow INR 3,210 thousand.

## Related parties and group exposure
No linked entities above the reporting threshold.

## Risk score
Probability of default 0.17, band medium.

## Policy exceptions
Rule 3.1: measured DSCR 1.08 against a floor of 1.25. Justification offered by the promoter is a one-off shutdown. Tenure under rule 6.1 is 36 months and is within limit.

## Recommendation: refer
Refer to the head of credit because of the rule 3.1 shortfall. No decision is taken in this draft.

cases.label: fail
cases.reason: Borderline, and the one the room should argue about. Every box is ticked: eight sections, rule 4.1 named, no approval language. But the prose calls the conduct clean and the file strong while five cheque returns breach rule 4.1 two paragraphs earlier. A rule-based check cannot see tone; a human can. Expect the judge to pass this one and expect to disagree.

checks.rule_text: No more than 3 cheque returns in 12 months
